name: Rödinghausen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:2:1, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Rödinghausen (red chevrons above a tower on white).
history: The flag of the municipality shows the municipal arms on a red, white and red ground striped lengthwise in the ratio 1:2:1.

features.role: Rödinghausen arms — chevrons and tower on white
